title: IBM App Connect Operator and App Connect Enterprise Certified Containers Operands could allow an attacker with the…
description: IBM App Connect Operator and App Connect Enterprise Certified Containers Operands contain a vulnerability that allows an attacker with the ability to run HTTP calls within the running container to make administrative calls to a running IntegrationRuntime. This could lead to high impact on integrity and availability without affecting confidentiality. The vulnerability has a medium severity score of 6.0 and requires high privileges to exploit.
